# Inume Opencode Retro Themes

> 13 free, MIT-licensed retro themes for OpenCode, the open-source terminal AI coding agent (TUI). Each theme recreates the look of classic hardware — Windows 95, CGA, SNES, PlayStation, GameCube, Game Boy, Famicom, IBM phosphor terminals, PCB circuit boards, and worn neon.

Themes are JSON files dropped into `~/.config/opencode/themes/` and activated with `/themes` inside OpenCode (which opens the theme selector), or set as the default in `cli.json` with `"theme": { "name": "<name>" }` on OpenCode 2.x (`"theme": "<name>"` in `tui.json` on OpenCode 1.x).

## Key pages

- [README](https://github.com/Gianlucabernasconi/Inume-Opencode-Retro-Themes/blob/main/README.md): theme list, screenshot gallery, and installation (one-liner or install script)
- [Themes folder](https://github.com/Gianlucabernasconi/Inume-Opencode-Retro-Themes/tree/main/themes): the 13 JSON theme files
- [Install script](https://github.com/Gianlucabernasconi/Inume-Opencode-Retro-Themes/blob/main/install.sh): interactive installer (`./install.sh`, `./install.sh all`, or specific theme names)
- [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai/): the terminal AI coding agent these themes target

## Themes

- w95-classic: Windows 95 — teal desktop, gray panels (fixed palette)
- norton-commander: Norton Commander — blue file-manager terminal (fixed palette)
- ibm-old-terminal: IBM PC terminal — green phosphor on black (fixed palette)
- cga: CGA palette — early PC color, cyan/black (fixed palette)
- theme-station-1: PlayStation 1 — pale gray shell
- theme-station-2: PlayStation 2 — deep black, blue aura
- theme-cube: Nintendo GameCube — purple hardware
- dot-matrix: Nintendo Game Boy — four-shade pea-green LCD (fixed palette)
- family-computheme: Nintendo Famicom — cream and red
- super-theme: Super Nintendo — soft gray, purple accents (fixed palette)
- super-color: SNES multicolor — brighter palette (fixed palette)
- silicon-trace: PCB circuits — chip traces, green board
- faded-neon: worn neon — dim pink/green glow (fixed palette)
